1500.translation: Abeg, you fit reduce the price small?

1501.translation: You dey market stall and want lower price.

1502.translation: Na this one I go take.

1503.translation: You don compare different things and just decide which one to buy.

1505.translation: You dey buy gift and want make dem wrap am as present.

1506.translation: A: How much these shoes be? B: Na 30,000 won. A: E cost small. You get pair wey cheaper? B: Yes, this one na 20,000 won.

1507.translation: A: I go pay with card. B: Sorry, card no dey work. Na only cash. A: Then I go pay cash.

1508.translation: A: I fit try wear this trouser? B: Yes, go that side. A: E small small. You get bigger size? B: Abeg, wait small.

1509.translation: Dem dey sell this bag for reduced price now.

1510.translation: Abeg, tell me if you need receipt.

1511.translation: Abeg, show your points card for payment counter.

1512.translation: The same item cheaper for another shop.

1513.translation: If you want your money back, abeg bring your receipt.

1514.translation: A: How much this umbrella be? B: Na 5,000 won. A: E cheaper if I buy two? B: Yes, na 8,000 won for two. A: Then give me two, abeg.

1515.translation: Notice: This shop no dey open on Mondays. From Tuesday reach Sunday, e dey open at ten for morning and close at eight for evening.

1521.translation: This bus dey go City Hall?

1522.translation: Destination particle dey mark where vehicle dey go.

1523.translation: How long e dey take reach Myeongdong?

1524.translation: One particle dey mark endpoint; another one dey mark starting point.

1525.translation: I dey enter subway from here.

1526.translation: I dey come down for City Hall Station.

1527.translation: The place-of-action particle also dey mark where person enter or come down from vehicle.

1529.translation: One particle fit show transport method or destination. Walking get its own adverb form.

1532.translation: E dey take thirty minutes to reach airport by taxi.

1536.translation: Wetin time the last train dey?

1541.translation: You dey taxi and don reach your destination.

1543.translation: You dey crowded bus and need move towards the door.

1545.translation: You dey drive taxi, and passenger just open the door.

1546.translation: A: How I go reach airport? B: Subway cheap. A: How long e dey take? B: About one hour.

1547.translation: A: This bus dey go City Hall? B: No, enter that bus over there. A: Which number? B: Number five.

1548.translation: A: Driver, abeg go this address. B: Okay, I don understand. A: How long e go take? B: About twenty minutes.

1549.translation: The next bus go come after fifteen minutes.

1550.translation: This subway train no dey stop for Gangnam Station.

1551.translation: If you want change train, come down for next station.

1552.translation: I need add money to my bus card.

1553.translation: Abeg, no talk loud for phone inside subway.

1554.translation: Announcement: We go soon reach City Hall Station. Doors wey you go use come down dey right side. Abeg, check say you no leave anything behind.

1557.translation: Verb wey join helper describing word fit show wetin the speaker want do.

1559.translation: The negative form of the want pattern dey show say speaker no want do something.

1566.translation: The film dey finish at half past two.

1567.translation: Special word for half dey come after the hour to show half past.

1568.translation: Na ten minutes past three now.

1569.translation: Clock hours use native Korean numbers; minutes use Sino-Korean numbers. Time particle dey mark the time.

1570.translation: I dey wake up at seven every day.

1572.translation: Me too, I want follow go.

1573.translation: Your friends dey plan journey, and you want join dem.

1575.translation: You dey late and urge your friend to move faster.

1577.translation: Your alarm ring for morning, but sleep still dey catch you.

1578.translation: A: Wetin you want do tomorrow? B: I want watch film. A: Wetin time we go watch am? B: Make we watch am at three.

1579.translation: A: Wetin time e be now? B: Na half past twelve. A: Hunger dey catch me. I want chop afternoon food. B: Me too. Make we chop together.

1580.translation: I want go seaside this weekend.

1581.translation: Instead of cooking today, I want chop outside.

1582.translation: I dey plan register for Korean class next month.

1584.translation: I hope say rain go stop.

1585.translation: I want try work for Korea.

1586.translation: A: Wetin you dey do this Saturday? B: I never know. I want rest for house. A: I go watch film. You want follow? B: Wetin time? A: At four for afternoon. B: Okay, make we go together.

1588.translation: -아/어 보이다 mean looks like one quality. E dey attach to the 아/어 form of describing word.

1589.translation: That cloth make you look young.

1601.translation: Road wet, so e be like say rain don fall.

1602.translation: -(으)ㄴ/는 모양이다 dey show guess based on evidence. Use -는 for present verbs, -(으)ㄴ for past verbs or describing words, and -(으)ㄹ for future.

1603.translation: My friend no come school, so e be like say my friend no well.

1604.translation: The pikin dey cry, so e be like say hunger dey catch the pikin.

1605.translation: People plenty, so e be like say this restaurant popular.

1606.translation: After noun, 모양이다 need copula for its noun-describing form (-인).

1607.translation: Person dey hold umbrella, so e be like say rain go fall.

1608.translation: E be like say that person na Korean.

1609.translation: The bag no dey, so e be like say the person don go house already.

1610.translation: My friend dey smile, so e be like say my friend happy.

1611.translation: Room quiet, so e be like say nobody dey there.

1612.translation: The face look sad, so e be like say the person no do well for exam.

1613.translation: The new trainers look comfortable, so me too, I want buy pair.

1614.translation: -아/어 보이다 dey show how something look from appearance: describing word take -아/어, then 보이다 follow. -는 모양이다 na guess from evidence, often after '-는 걸 보니'.

1615.translation: That restaurant door close, so e be like say dem no open today.

1616.translation: This cloth look more classy in real life than for photo.

1617.translation: Children dey gather for field, so e be like say game go soon start.

1618.translation: My younger sibling look much smarter with eyeglasses.

1619.translation: A: Our workmate for the same team look tired these days. B: True. E be like say the workmate work till late last night too. A: Then make we buy afternoon food for the person today? B: Good idea. Make we buy coffee too.

1621.translation: Before noun, describing word take -(으)ㄴ after consonant or -ㄴ after vowel. Words wey contain 있다/없다 take -는.

1624.translation: I want live for big house.

1626.translation: The person wey dey read book over there na my younger sibling.

1627.translation: Before noun, verb take -는 for present, -(으)ㄴ for past, and -(으)ㄹ for future or planned action.

1628.translation: The food wey I chop yesterday sweet.

1629.translation: The film wey I watch yesterday interesting.

1630.translation: The friend wey I go meet tomorrow na student.

1631.translation: I buy clothes wey I go wear tomorrow.

1632.translation: For days wey rain dey fall, I dey stay house.

1633.translation: I get friend wey dey live for Korea.

1634.translation: For ㅂ-irregular describing words, ㅂ dey change to 우 before -ㄴ. Verbs wey end with ㄹ drop ㄹ before -는.

1635.translation: The person wey dey over there na teacher.

1636.translation: Plenty people wey no get money dey.

1638.translation: The person wey dey smile for photo na my mama.

1639.translation: The bag wey I buy yesterday cost well-well.

1640.translation: The food wey I like na bulgogi.

1641.translation: Who be the person wey you meet yesterday?

1645.translation: the film wey I watch yesterday

1646.translation: the place wey I go go tomorrow

1649.translation: Tomorrow, I go return the book wey I borrow from library.

1650.translation: Before noun, verb or describing word take noun-describing ending: -(으)ㄴ for past, -는 for present (or -ㄴ/은 for describing words), -(으)ㄹ for future or planned action, and -던 for past habit or unfinished past action. The time depend on the action wey e describe, no be only the main verb.

1651.translation: I dey often listen to songs wey popular these days.

1652.translation: The house wey I go move to next month near school.

1653.translation: I want study for cafe wey no noisy.

1654.translation: Workmate wey I dey work with last year call yesterday.

1655.translation: I tire, so I go sleep early.

1656.translation: -아/어서 fit join reason or sequence: do A, then B. For this reason pattern, dem no dey follow am with requests. Time dey show for the final ending.

1657.translation: Rain fall, so I stay house.

1658.translation: I go school and meet friend.

1659.translation: This cloth fine, but e cost well-well.

1660.translation: -지만 mean but, and e dey attach to plain stem of verbs, describing words and 이다.

1662.translation: E cold, so abeg close door.

1663.translation: -(으)면 mean if or when. -(으)니까 fit give reason wey lead to request or discovery.

1664.translation: When I open door, cat dey there.

1665.translation: If you get time, make we watch film together.

1666.translation: If rain fall tomorrow, I go stay house.

1667.translation: I dey study Korean because I want go Korea.

1668.translation: -(으)려고 + verb dey show purpose, in order to do something. -는데/-(으)ㄴ데 dey set background or mild contrast.

1669.translation: I go bookshop to buy book.

1670.translation: I enter subway to meet friend.

1671.translation: I dey live for Seoul, but my friend dey live for Busan.

1672.translation: The food sweet, but e too expensive.

1673.translation: Rain dey fall, and I no get umbrella.

1674.translation: I dey chop food, then drink coffee.

1675.translation: -고 dey list actions or qualities in order, like and.

1676.translation: My elder sister tall and fine.

1677.translation: For weekend, I watch film and go shopping too.

1678.translation: I no get money, so I no fit buy am.

1679.translation: My head pain me, so I go hospital.

1680.translation: Work plenty, but I go leave early today.

1681.translation: I no understand Korean, so e hard.

1682.translation: If I drink coffee, sleep no dey come.

1684.translation: I wash my hair before I meet my friend.

1685.translation: Time connectors dey join verb stem for fixed forms: -기 전에 (before), -(으)ㄴ 후에 (after), -(으)ㄹ 때 (when), -자마자 (as soon as). -(으)러 show purpose only with 가다/오다 and similar movement verbs.

1686.translation: I dey play games after I finish homework.

1687.translation: Abeg, no look your phone when you dey cross road.

1688.translation: Thirst catch me, so I go drink water.

1689.translation: As soon as I reach house, I take shower.

1690.translation: A: Wetin happen this morning? B: Bus spoil, so I change enter subway. A: E must don hard for you. B: No be so. I still reach before meeting start.

1692.translation: Formal polite statements end with -ㅂ니다 after vowel and -습니다 after consonant. Questions use -ㅂ니까 / -습니까.

1702.translation: Formal past ending na -았/었습니다; formal future ending na -(으)ㄹ 겁니다. For question, 다 dey change to 까.

1707.translation: Verbs wey end with ㄹ drop am before ㅂ, so ㄹ no dey before -ㅂ니다 for formal form.

1708.translation: I dey open shop door for morning.

1710.translation: I dey wake up at seven for morning.

1713.translation: The meeting dey start at two for afternoon.

1714.translation: Formal polite endings -ㅂ니다/-습니다 for statements and -ㅂ니까/-습니까 for questions dey useful for work, announcements and customers. Honorific -(으)시- dey show respect to person, no be objects or events.

1716.translation: Where I fit collect application form?

1717.translation: We go begin use the new rules from next week.

1718.translation: Our company dey near Seoul City Hall.

1719.translation: A: Hello. Abeg, tell me the name wey you use book. B: Na Kim Minsu. Na three people book. A: Okay, I don confirm am. I go show una table near window.

1721.translation: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다 mean can, for ability or possibility. -(으)ㄹ 수 없다 mean cannot.

1723.translation: I busy today, so I no fit go.

1724.translation: I no fit chop peppery food.

1726.translation: This problem hard, so I no fit solve am.

1727.translation: I must wake up early tomorrow.

1728.translation: -아/어야 하다 (or 되다) mean must or need to. E dey attach to the 아/어 form of verb.

1729.translation: I must do my homework today.

1730.translation: I catch cold, so I must take medicine.

1734.translation: -아/어도 되다 fit ask or give permission. Negative before am fit mean no need to do something.

1736.translation: E dey okay to chop now?

1737.translation: You no need come early tomorrow.

1739.translation: -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다/없다 dey show whether person don do something before. 아/어 보다 often dey come before am.

1744.translation: I never meet Korean friend before.

1745.translation: You don watch that film before?

1747.translation: You dey encourage friend wey dey nervous before exam.

1748.translation: No, you no fit do that.

1749.translation: Person wey you no know ask whether e fit park for front of your shop entrance, and you refuse.
